segments.oily: Reviewers with normal-to-oily or oily skin report mixed results: some describe bad breakouts and greasiness that never absorbs, while others (normal-oily) report no irritation and smoother, more even skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report good tolerance and hydration with no irritation, though a couple find the oil slow to absorb or requiring more product than expected.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive mostly report no burning, irritation, or reaction and describe the oil as gentle and hydrating, but a minority report peeling, itching, stinging, and rashes that led them to stop using it.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature skin (often stating their age, 44 to 72) consistently report softer skin, reduced fine lines and wrinkles, lightened sun spots, and no irritation or dryness.
segments.combination: One reviewer with normal-to-oily/combination skin reports a fairly bad breakout after use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, plumper skin, and softer wrinkles, including around the eyes and neck, often within a few weeks; a few say they cannot tell if it is truly working versus just hydrating the skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the oil as very hydrating, leaving skin soft, dewy, and never tight the next morning; one reviewer with dry skin says it does not absorb well and stays greasy on the skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation even with frequent use; however, one reviewer describes extreme drying, peeling, and burning/stinging when layering other products, and another reports a rash around the eyes after resuming use too quickly.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the product with helping restore her skin barrier; others report no adverse reaction to their skin barrier, though a few describe peeling or a burning sensation without sunscreen.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report lightened dark spots, age spots, and sun-damage marks with continued use over weeks to months.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: multiple reviewers describe new breakouts, bumps, or forehead purging (some framing it as a temporary purge, others as a lasting problem), while several other reviewers say it cleared hormonal breakouts or caused no breakouts at all.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers say the oil feels greasy and sits on the skin without absorbing, while others, including oily-skin reviewers, describe it as lightweight, non-sticky, and sinking in with no greasy residue.
